# "Karna donates the kavach" - shot plan (folk2d example)

Timing comes from `work/phrases.json` (made by `timing.py`), never the other way round. Shots start at the first phrase they illustrate:

| # | shot | first phrase starts at | setting / light | camera | cast / action | fx + sfx |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | hook | "क्या आप जानते" | night sky, moon, ridge | push-in 1.0 -> 1.18 | Karna centre, rotating bead ring, rays; title pops on "सूर्यपुत्र कर्ण" | swell, chime |
| 2 | armor | "कर्ण के जन्म से" | dusk, sun | glide in on the chest | bead ring fills (18 beads) while "कवच / कुंडल" pop; "अजेय" on "जब तक ये" | sparkle, thunk |
| 3 | war | "लेकिन महाभारत" | heaven sky, cloud throne | slow push | Indra thinking, thought bubble "अर्जुन" | dhol x2 |
| 4 | brahmin | "वो एक बूढ़े" | dawn, river, sun (white flash in) | slow pan right | Brahmin walks in (leg swing), Karna gives alms (bowl) | whoosh, bell |
| 5 | ask | "ब्राह्मण ने कर्ण से कहा" | dawn two-shot | slow push | Brahmin pleads, mouth moves on the quote, speech bubble | pop |
| 6 | realize | "कर्ण समझ गया" | dawn -> dream (Surya vision) | roll + push | Brahmin becomes Indra (ring wave + sparks), Karna shock -> worry | sparkle, heart, swell |
| 7 | smile | "लेकिन कर्ण ने फिर भी" | day, sun rays | push-in | Karna namaste, quote text pops | chime |
| 8 | donate | "इसके बाद कर्ण ने अपनी कटार" | fire sky -> dusk | push right | dagger raised, armor off, ONE drop + soft red glow (no gore), kavach floats to Indra | riser, slice, drip, chime |
| 9 | bow | "ये देखकर" (white flash in) | heaven, rays | slow push | Indra reveals and bows, holds the kavach, Karna bare-chested and calm | whoosh, bell |
| 10 | compare | "सोचिए" | split frame, ornament divider | none | top: Indra (छल), bottom: Karna (वचन) | click |
| 11 | payoff | "कवच चला गया" (white flash in) | dusk, giant sun, 3 mandala rings | pull back | "अमर" pops on the closing line | riser, chime |
| 12 | cta | "ऐसी ही महाभारत" | night, lotus, mandala | slow push | channel name pops, paper plane, Follow -> Following | whoosh, pop |

Music (tanpura + bansuri + soft tabla) stops at shot 8 (the donation), the drone stays, and the music returns at shot 11.
Length note: this script is about 390 words, roughly 2.5-3 minutes at normal Hindi narration. Trim to about 150-220 words for a 60-90 s Reel.
